invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.17.0 preserves Parts 1–15 and completes Part 16 Kenya eTIMS with KRA-native OSCU/VSCU device activation, encrypted OSCU communication-key storage, KRA item/tax mappings, solution-scoped fiscal invoice sequencing, invoice and credit-note submission evidence, authority result-code acceptance, protected production delivery and immutable fiscalized PDFs. The standalone responsive Invoicing shell remains module-owned; migrations stay additive so workspace users are not blocked by version drift. Future changes must keep Invoicing, app-surface, ERP integration, platform closure, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
